messages:
michael: Hey all — quick check on the next release window. With the UK bank holiday falling on Tue 3/24, should we shift the cutoff one day earlier or keep the biweekly cadence and ask owners to freeze changes?

anna: I vote bump cutoff to Fri 3/20. Gives QA time. :thumbsup:

liam: Agree. If we move cutoff we should also nudge the changelog owners to freeze PRs that day. I'll DM the team.

sheila: Can we do a soft freeze from 3/20 18:00 UTC — only security/urgent fixes after that. Saves a hard branch cut.

michael: Sounds good. If we do that, can eng-release rotation owners confirm they can cover monitoring on 3/24? @carmen?

carmen: I can cover on 3/24 morning US PST. Will set calendar event.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: release-window-check — cutoff=1778630400 (Fri 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC). Reminder set 48h before.

liam: Also, small ask — CI is flaky for long-running integration tests when branches diverge. If we bump cutoff, let's rebase feature/X onto main by EOD Thu.

anna: I'll ping teams with example command: `git checkout feature/X && git rebase main && ./ci/run-smoke.sh`

sheila: Also adding a changelog nudge comment template:

```text
Please add a brief changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md. If it's minor, mark as "skip".
``` 

liam: Can someone update the release calendar event title to include "holiday window" so folks see it in global calendars?

michael: done — updated title and added Slack reminder. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short RFC if we want permanent policy for holiday weeks.
